signals.ai_share_evidence: No AI-generation markers; 32 small README edits across 14 distinct days spanning 2021-2025 show sustained hand curation. One automated commit is by 'blog-post-bot' via the declared blog-post-workflow.yml GitHub Action — disclosed automation, not covert generation.

evidence.excerpt: Metadata: profile repo, 99 stars, 32 commits over 14 distinct days, created 2021-10-04, pushed 2025-12-14, 2 contributors (owner + bot), CI present, no deps.

'Create blog-post-workflow.yml' (2021-10-04), 'Updated with the latest blog posts' by author blog-post-bot (2021-10-04), then years of edits: 'Revise personal introduction in README.md ... Removed outdated job titles' (2025-09-16), 'Fix typo in README.md' (2025-11-09), 'Fix formatting issues in README.md' (2025-12-14).
Root entries: .github/ (workflows), README.md, bg_book.png — the standard shape of a GitHub profile README repo.
workflows-listing.json shows one workflow: .github/workflows/blog-post-workflow.yml (628 bytes) — the blog-feed automation referenced by the bot commit.

'I run the open-source Awesome LLM Apps ... Senior AI Product Manager at Google Cloud ... Co-author of GPT-3: The Ultimate Guide ... Angel investing in the early-stage AI Agent startups (typical cheque size: $25-50k)'.

counter_evidence.excerpt: The one claim checkable against saved portfolio data holds: awesome-llm-apps exists in this account's metadata snapshot with 122,625 stars and 1,080 commits.

strongest_counter_evidence: Four-plus years of dated, incremental README revisions including removing outdated job titles — self-correcting rather than inflating
The flagship claim (running awesome-llm-apps) is corroborated by the account's own metadata snapshot
counter_evidence_review.review_notes: Low code-backed ratio is inherent to a profile README: employment, book authorship, newsletter, and investing claims point off-GitHub and are simply not verifiable from the saved artifacts; they are recorded as unverified, not as false.

notes: GitHub profile README repo maintained by hand from 2021 through 2025, with a declared blog-post GitHub Action (one bot commit) and a history that includes removing outdated job titles. Of six biographical claims only the awesome-llm-apps ownership is verifiable from saved artifacts (it is, at 122K stars in the metadata snapshot); the rest are external biography, unverifiable offline by nature. No red flags beyond that inherent unverifiability.
